title: [YSQL][randgen] yb::pggate::PgTableDesc::DecodeYbctid(yb::Slice const&) const hits SIGABRT with BitmapScan
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10379](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10379)
### Description

Problem
---
* Reproducible in a recent master (305dbefe92).
* Server crash with SIGABRT somewhere below `yb::pggate::PgTableDesc::DecodeYbctid(yb::Slice const&) const` while executing a plan using BitmapScans.

```
YB test# SELECT table1 .col_int_key  AS field1  , table1 .col_varchar_key  AS field2  , table1 .col_varchar_key  AS field3  , ( ( table1 .col_int_nokey  )  + ( table2 .pk  )  )  AS field4  FROM ( (  SELECT SUBQUERY1_t1 .* FROM ( C  AS SUBQUERY1_t1  INNER  JOIN BB  AS SUBQUERY1_t2  ON ( SUBQUERY1_t2 .col_int_key  = SUBQUERY1_t1 .pk  )  )  )  AS table1  JOIN (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table2  ON ( table2 .col_varchar_key  = table1 .col_varchar_key  )  )  WHERE table1 .col_int_key  IN (  SELECT col_int_nokey  FROM C  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  != table2 .col_varchar_key  AND SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_nokey  >= table2 .col_varchar_nokey  )  AND table1 .pk  = table2 .col_int_key  OR table1 .col_int_key  = table2 .col_int_key   ;
server closed the connection unexpectedly
	This probably means the server terminated abnormally
	before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
psql (15.1, server 11.2-YB-2.21.1.0-b0)
YB test# EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT table1 .col_int_key  AS field1  , table1 .col_varchar_key  AS field2  , table1 .col_varchar_key  AS field3  , ( ( table1 .col_int_nokey  )  + ( table2 .pk  )  )  AS field4  FROM ( (  SELECT SUBQUERY1_t1 .* FROM ( C  AS SUBQUERY1_t1  INNER  JOIN BB  AS SUBQUERY1_t2  ON ( SUBQUERY1_t2 .col_int_key  = SUBQUERY1_t1 .pk  )  )  )  AS table1  JOIN (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table2  ON ( table2 .col_varchar_key  = table1 .col_varchar_key  )  )  WHERE table1 .col_int_key  IN (  SELECT col_int_nokey  FROM C  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  != table2 .col_varchar_key  AND SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_nokey  >= table2 .col_varchar_nokey  )  AND table1 .pk  = table2 .col_int_key  OR table1 .col_int_key  = table2 .col_int_key   ;
                                                                          QUERY PLAN
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 YB Batched Nested Loop Join
   Join Filter: (subquery1_t1.pk = subquery1_t2.col_int_key)
   ->  Nested Loop
         ->  Seq Scan on c
         ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on c subquery1_t1
               Filter: (((SubPlan 1) AND (pk = c.col_int_key)) OR (col_int_key = c.col_int_key))
               ->  BitmapAnd
                     ->  BitmapOr
                           ->  Bitmap Index Scan on c_pkey
                                 Index Cond: (pk = c.col_int_key)
                           ->  Bitmap Index Scan on c_int_key
                                 Index Cond: (col_int_key = c.col_int_key)
                     ->  Bitmap Index Scan on c_varchar_key
                           Index Cond: ((col_varchar_key)::text = (c.col_varchar_key)::text)
               SubPlan 1
                 ->  Seq Scan on c subquery3_t1
                       Storage Filter: (((col_varchar_key)::text <> (c.col_varchar_key)::text) AND ((col_varchar_nokey)::text >= (c.col_varchar_nokey)::text))
   ->  Index Only Scan using bb_int_key on bb subquery1_t2
         Index Cond: (col_int_key = ANY (ARRAY[subquery1_t1.pk, $7, $8, ..., $1029]))
(19 rows)
```

**No crash with BitmapScans disabled:**
```
YB test# /*+ Set(enable_bitmapscan OFF) */SELECT table1 .col_int_key  AS field1  , table1 .col_varchar_key  AS field2  , table1 .col_varchar_key  AS field3  , ( ( table1 .col_int_nokey  )  + ( table2 .pk  )  )  AS field4  FROM ( (  SELECT SUBQUERY1_t1 .* FROM ( C  AS SUBQUERY1_t1  INNER  JOIN BB  AS SUBQUERY1_t2  ON ( SUBQUERY1_t2 .col_int_key  = SUBQUERY1_t1 .pk  )  )  )  AS table1  JOIN (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table2  ON ( table2 .col_varchar_key  = table1 .col_varchar_key  )  )  WHERE table1 .col_int_key  IN (  SELECT col_int_nokey  FROM C  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  != table2 .col_varchar_key  AND SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_nokey  >= table2 .col_varchar_nokey  )  AND table1 .pk  = table2 .col_int_key  OR table1 .col_int_key  = table2 .col_int_key   ;
 field1 | field2 | field3 | field4
--------+--------+--------+--------
      1 | p      | p      |     12
(1 row)
```

```

server closed the connection unexpectedly
	This probably means the server terminated abnormally
	before or while processing the request.
The connection to the server was lost. Attempting reset: Succeeded.
psql (15.1, server 11.2-YB-2.21.1.0-b0)
YB test#
```
